annotations.title: Approve or reject one inbox item

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Decides ONE item from approvals_list (`id`): decision "approve" or "reject", optional `note`. ALWAYS show the user the item's `summary` (e.g. "Monthly ad spend cap: $500.00 → $1,200.00") and get a clear yes before approving. Ad budget requests ("ad_budget") need `approvals:decide`: approving a cap change applies it at once; approving any other request lets the agent repeat its exact call once within 7 days. If the workspace requires money approvals to be restated, the answer is 409 `confirmation_required`: repeat with `confirmAmountMinor` equal to `amountMinor` (null for "remove the limit"), only after the user confirmed that amount. Held content works as in decide_approval (`approve` or `approvals:decide`; a workflow approval may resume a run that publishes). Repeating the same decision is safe (alreadyDecided: true). Every decision is audited with who, when and that it came through MCP.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/approvals/{id}.)

confirmAmountMinor.description: Format: integer or null; e.g. 0. Ad budget requests only: restate `amountMinor` (cents; null when it is null) when the workspace requires money confirmation.

id.description: Format: string; e.g. "id_123". An approval id.

note.description: Format: string; e.g. "Example". On reject: the reason. Optional unless the org requires one.
